articles.title: The Clarity Act will put Main Street banks at a disadvantage
articles.snippet: The Blockchain Association’s Summer Mersinger dismisses the harm to community banks in defending the stablecoin rewards language in the Clarity Act, says community banker Nate Franzén.

articles.title: Mirae Asset eyes $109 billion crypto empire after acquiring Digital X
articles.snippet: Park Hyeon-joo, Mirae Asset Financial Group’s founder, outlined his ambitious stablecoin, RWAs, and STOs plan for Digital X, formerly known as Korbit, in an event for his employees.

articles.title: Britain plans new Bank of England objective for stablecoins
articles.snippet: Financial stability would remain its primary duty, with annual reports to Parliament on the new objective being planned.

articles.title: Trump cost investors $4.7B through crypto ‘schemes’: Public Citizen
articles.snippet: While investors in World Liberty Financial‘s USD1 stablecoin “haven’t suffered major losses,” many lost billions of dollars in other Trump ventures, according to Public Citizen.

articles.title: Mirae Asset lays out crypto, stablecoin, tokenization plans for Digital X
articles.snippet: The South Korean financial group plans to build a $109 billion digital asset business spanning crypto, stablecoins and tokenized assets, according to The Korea Times.
